meta.name: SparkForge Full Control Screen
meta.description: Master cockpit UI layout specification. Defines every visual element, position, material, and interaction in the 3D panoramic cockpit. Source of truth for the full 3D UI migration.
meta.design_language: Opaque metallic control panel with high-polish chrome bezels, matte-black carbon composite surfaces, physical 3D dials/buttons/switches. Holographic glow LIMITED to center lab map only.
meta.perspective: First-person, 1-foot from panel face, 130-degree forward curvature

carbon_composite.description: Matte-black base surface for all panel faces

chrome_bezel.description: High-polish chrome for every edge, button housing, and structural frame

control_panel.description: Dark wet-glass surface for interactive screen areas

button_idle.description: Subtle glow for idle interactive elements

holographic.description: ONLY for center lab map and small data readouts

center_bloom.description: Blue holographic bloom from center screen ONLY

floor.description: Grated floor with sub-floor piping, energy conduits, LED channels

structural_detail.description: Cable bundles, vent panels, ribs, LED indicator strips

quadrant_layout.design_principle: Left (identity) and Right (control) are FIXED across all pages. Center SWAPS content per route — it is the cockpit's main screen. Bottom is FIXED instruments.

shell.description: Spherical panoramic main screen shell. Content inside changes per route.

components.description: Interactive 3D lab network — 10 pulsing nodes, geodesic shells, data highways. ONLY holographic element in cockpit.

interactive.click: Focus lab, fly camera, show detail overlay
interactive.hover: Pulse glow, show lab name + completion %

components.style: Orbitron font, #F0F0F4 primary, #00BBFF accent, chrome-bordered panel
components.description: Floating welcome header with quick stats above the lab map

components.label: Continue: {last_lab} — {last_game}
components.description: Prominent CTA to resume last session. Spring-press animation, LED pulse on hover.
Lab map zoomed in, nodes larger, completion % visible per node. Click to focus, double-click to enter.

interactive.click: Focus lab — camera flies to node, right panel shows game list

components.description: Single lab structure with interior mechanisms, diorama view. Orbiting game cards float around it.
components.dynamic: Lab ID determines which structure renders

components.description: Each game in the lab shown as a floating card. Click to launch game. Shows completion status, tier badge.
All 35 games displayed as holographic tiles. Filterable by lab (LED rim changes color). Shows tier badge, completion star, play count.

per_tile.content: game icon + name + tier badge + completion status

/arcade/[gameSlug].description: Center screen EXPANDS to 75% of total viewport. Game 3D environment fills expanded center. Left, right, bottom panels slide partially offscreen and dim to 40% opacity.
/arcade/[gameSlug].cockpit_panel_offset: panels slide 30% toward edges (left further left, right further right, bottom lower)
/arcade/[gameSlug].transition: MechanicalIris wipe opens to expanded view. Camera FOV widens from 58 to 72.

components.description: Full game 3D environment fills expanded center viewport

components.position: floating panels within game scene, positioned by game type
components.description: Score gauge, timer, quiz buttons — all rendered as 3D objects inside game scene
3D trophy room with metallic pedestals. 9 badge categories as tab buttons along top. Earned badges glow, locked badges are dim chrome. Hover sparkle + detail popup.
When on profile page, center also shows enlarged avatar with cosmetic selection ring

left_quadrant.behavior: FIXED — Player Identity Hub. Content is always about WHO YOU ARE. Slight emphasis shifts per page but layout stays consistent.

avatar_viewport.description: 3D avatar with rotation capability, cosmetic display. On /profile, expands slightly and shows cosmetic selector ring.

ai_guide_avatar.description: Floating semi-transparent AI guide hologram with idle animation. Speaks during onboarding, pulses when guide chat is active.

trophy_display.description: Shows 3 most recently earned badges as mini trophies. Click to navigate to /profile trophy room.

left_radial_gauges.description: 4 small radial gauges showing player vital stats. Always visible. Values update in real-time via Zustand subscriptions.

right_quadrant.behavior: FIXED — Control & Monitoring Hub. Always about WHAT'S HAPPENING and WHAT YOU CAN CONTROL. Settings panel shows key toggles; activity log streams events; quick actions provide shortcuts.

settings_panel.description: Quick-access settings: 2 toggle switches + 2 dials. On /settings page, these sync with the expanded center settings panel.

activity_log.description: Vertical scrollable feed of recent activity. Chrome-bordered cards with connection lines between entries. New entries animate in from top with spring physics.

quick_actions.description: 4 quick-action buttons with hover glow and press animation. Always accessible regardless of current page.

bottom_module.behavior: FIXED — Instrument Panel. Layout never changes. Only dial labels/values update per page. Like a car dashboard.

variable_dials.description: 3 physical dials that auto-reconfigure per page context

navigation_buttons.description: 5 large illuminated physical buttons. Active button stays depressed with pulsing glow. Press broadcasts page-navigate event.

quick_stats_bar.description: XP speedometer needle, streak flame animation, 10 lab color indicators, session timer. Always visible, always updating.

hud.description: Concentric ring system with data arcs — subtle, not dominant

led_rim.description: Ultra-bright status strip along cockpit edge

user_profile_badge.description: Top-right profile badge with notification bell

mode_presets.description: Each route triggers a different cockpit mood. 8 atmosphere layers change per mode: bloom, camera, vignette, LED, HUD, panels, particles, audio. Transitions between non-game modes use smooth crossfade (400ms). Game mode uses MechanicalIris.

transition_default.description: Center content fades old→new. LED color interpolates. Camera FOV lerps. No hard cuts.

dashboard.atmosphere: Calm command bridge. Blue-dominant. Lab map glowing in center. Steady instrument readings. Home base feeling.

labs.atmosphere: Exploration mode. Wider FOV reveals more of the lab ring. Slightly brighter bloom. HUD shows minimap. Ready to dive into a lab.

lab_detail.atmosphere: Focused on a single lab. LED rim shifts to lab color. Higher particle density. HUD switches to lab-focus data. Tighter FOV draws attention to center structure.

game.atmosphere: Game immersion. Center viewport EXPANDS to 75% of screen. Cockpit panels retract and dim to 40%. HUD hidden. Wider FOV. No barrel distortion. Cockpit becomes a faint frame around the game world.

profile.atmosphere: Personal space. Purple-tinted LED rim. Trophy room in center catches light. Left panel avatar expands slightly. Reflective, rewarding mood.

settings.atmosphere: Engineering mode. Amber LED tint. Center shows settings panels with physical controls. Right panel settings sync with center. Reduced particles — clean, utilitarian.

celebration.trigger: XP gain, badge earn, level-up, game complete

effects.led_flash: Gold pulse wave across all 1500 LEDs
effects.bloom_spike: Bloom peaks at 0.8 then decays to previous mode

celebration.atmosphere: DRAMATIC BURST. Gold LEDs flash. HUD rings expand and spin. Bloom spikes. 3D confetti and trophies materialize. 2-3 second cinematic moment then smoothly fades back to previous mode.

parent.center_content: parent analytics panels — children overview, time limits, subscription status, usage graphs
parent.atmosphere: Responsible adult mode. Amber tint. Reduced cockpit intensity — panels at 70%, bloom subdued. Center shows clean data panels. Focus on readability over spectacle.

interaction_model.description: All user interaction happens through raycasting on 3D objects, keyboard fallback, and cockpitBroadcastStore event bus. No DOM click events on dashboard pages. Mouse cursor changes reflect interactivity.

pointer.raycaster: Three.js Raycaster from camera through mouse position. Hits 3D meshes and uikit containers.

cursor_mapping.default: crosshair — cockpit aesthetic cursor over non-interactive surfaces
cursor_mapping.interactive: pointer — over buttons, cards, lab nodes, dials, toggles
cursor_mapping.draggable: grab / grabbing — over RadialDial3D during rotation, game drag elements

hover.description: Layered feedback system: buttons/cards get glow+scale, panels/containers get chrome edge-trace.

on_hover.audio: electromagnetic_hum from element's spatial zone (if mechanical density > 0.3)

on_hover.edge_highlight: Chrome edge-trace — a bright white/cyan line (opacity 0.3) traces the border of the panel. Like a spotlight scanning the frame edge.

on_press.depress: 0.03 units on local Z axis (button physically pushes into panel)
on_press.emissive_spike: emissive intensity spikes to 2.5, decays over 0.3s
on_press.ripple: Radial ring expansion from press point (RingGeometry, additive blending, 0.5s expand + fade)
on_press.broadcast: cockpitBroadcastStore event (type based on button: page-navigate, button-press, etc.)

on_release.spring_return: spring physics bounce-back to rest position (stiffness 500, damping 20)

on_click.lever_snap: 45-degree rotation to opposite position with spring physics overshoot
on_click.led_indicator: LED dot changes color (off=#333, on=accent color)

on_drag.rotation: Dial rotates to follow mouse drag angle (polar coordinates). Spring-damped to prevent overshoot.
on_drag.tick_marks: Active tick mark highlights as needle passes it
on_drag.audio: whirr_continuous from element's zone — pitch maps to current value
on_drag.broadcast: dial-rotate event with current value (throttled to 60fps)

on_release.snap: Snaps to nearest tick mark if snap mode enabled

on_click.camera_fly: Camera interpolates to focused lab position over 800ms (spring easing)
on_click.node_expand: Clicked lab node scales 1.5x, other nodes dim to 40%
on_click.right_panel: Right quadrant shows lab's game list

scroll.behavior: Mouse wheel scrolls the uikit container under the cursor. If no scrollable container under cursor, wheel does nothing (cockpit doesn't page-scroll).
scroll.scroll_indicator: Thin LED strip along container edge — brightness indicates scroll position (top=bright at top, bottom=bright at bottom)
scroll.overscroll: rubber-band spring (bounces back when exceeding bounds)

text_input.rendering: Text rendered as SDF glyphs inside Canvas. Hidden HTML <input> element proxies keyboard events, paste, and autocomplete.

styling.caret: blinking vertical bar, accent color, 1s blink cycle

focus_behavior.on_click: Focus the hidden HTML input. Show caret in 3D. Chrome edge-trace highlights the input container.
focus_behavior.on_type: Characters appear in 3D text with slight spring animation per character (scale from 1.2 to 1.0 over 0.1s)
focus_behavior.on_paste: Pasted text appears instantly, no per-character animation
focus_behavior.on_blur: Caret disappears, edge-trace fades, hidden input blurs

drag_and_drop.phase: Phase 5+ (game UIs only — SortToyBox, CodeBlocks, etc.)
drag_and_drop.behavior: Raycaster identifies draggable mesh. On pointerDown, mesh follows mouse position projected onto a drag plane. Drop zones highlight when dragged mesh overlaps. Spring physics on release.

visual_feedback.dragging: Mesh lifts 0.1 units toward camera, shadow intensifies, opacity 0.9
visual_feedback.invalid_drop: Drop zone border flashes red (#FF6644), mesh springs back to origin

behavior.on_hover_delay: 300ms before tooltip appears (prevents flicker on mouse pass-through)
behavior.position: Offset from element — above for bottom elements, below for top elements, to the side for side elements. Auto-avoids occluding the hovered element.
behavior.z_offset: 0.15 toward camera (ensures tooltip renders in front)

styling.accent_line: Thin LED accent line at top, element's accent color

modals.description: Dialog content replaces current center viewport content. No overlay dimming — the center screen IS the dialog. Press close button or navigate away to return to previous content.

behavior.open: Current center content crossfades out (200ms). Dialog content crossfades in (300ms). LED rim pulses once in dialog accent color.
behavior.close: Dialog crossfades out (200ms). Previous content crossfades back in (300ms). Triggered by close button, Escape key, or navigation.
behavior.close_button: HolographicButton in top-right of dialog panel, labeled 'X' or 'Close'

layout.sections: icon/emoji + title (Exo 2) + body text (Sora) + action buttons (HolographicButton row)

keyboard.scope: Navigation buttons + center primary action — mouse is primary input
tab_order: NavigationButtonGrid: HOME → LABS → ARCADE → SETTINGS → PROFILE
Center primary action: Continue Learning CTA (on /home), focused lab node (on /labs), first game tile (on /arcade)

keys.Escape: Close modal dialog, exit text input focus, return focus to nav buttons
keys.Arrow Up/Down: Navigate within center scroll containers (activity log, game grid)

focus_indicator.type: Bright glow outline around focused element

broadcast_integration.description: Every interaction broadcasts to cockpitBroadcastStore, which drives cross-panel visual + audio reactions.
broadcast_integration.flow: User action → component handler → broadcast(event) → all subscribed cockpit components react

reactions: LED rim: purple pulse wave sweeps across 218° arc
VariableDialCluster: dials reconfigure to labs config (Completion / Games / Quiz Avg)
Center viewport: crossfade from current content to labs map (400ms)
Audio: whoosh_crossfade from center_screen zone + nav button metallic_thunk from bottom_console zone
Active nav button: LABS stays depressed with pulsing purple glow

accessibility.description: Accessibility in a full 3D UI requires special consideration. Screen readers cannot parse Canvas content, so we maintain sr-only HTML and keyboard navigation as fallbacks.

screen_reader.strategy: sr-only HTML nav links (Sidebar.tsx) provide Tab-accessible navigation. ARIA live regions announce state changes (XP gains, badge earns, page transitions).
screen_reader.component: src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx — renders sr-only <nav> with links to all routes
screen_reader.aria_live: Dashboard layout includes aria-live='polite' region that announces: route changes, XP updates, level-ups, badge earns, game start/complete

keyboard.nav_buttons: 5 NavigationButtonGrid buttons are Tab-accessible via sr-only Sidebar links. Enter activates navigation.
keyboard.center_action: Primary CTA in center viewport has keyboard focus after nav buttons.
keyboard.escape: Returns focus to navigation, closes modals

effects: Skip hero animation entirely — jump to cockpit
Disable spring physics — use instant transitions
Reduce celebration to single badge display (no confetti/fireworks)
Crossfade transitions reduced to instant swap
Emissive intensity increased 2x on all interactive elements
Focus indicator width increased from 3px to 5px

audio_zones.description: 3-layer spatial audio system. All synthesized via Web Audio API (no audio files). Zones realigned to finalized quadrant positions. Dense mechanical + atmospheric spatial hybrid. Full user customization via settings.

ambient.description: Persistent skin-reactive drone (45-65Hz sine) + pink noise. Always running. Crossfades between skins over 2.5s.

spatial.description: Positioned 3D audio sources. Sound direction matches zone position relative to camera. Creates sense of physical space.

events.description: One-shot synthesized sounds for interactions. Each event plays from the spatial position of the triggering element.

user_audio_settings.description: Full audio customization exposed in /settings mode. All bindable to ToggleSwitch3D and RadialDial3D controls.

sounds.drone: Skin-reactive sine oscillator (45-65Hz). Lab frequency offset: L1=0, L2=+5, L3=-3, L4=+8, L5=-5, L6=+3, L7=-8, L8=+10, L9=-2, L10=+7 Hz

cockpit_ambient.description: Omnidirectional ambient. Fills the entire cockpit. Skin and lab modulated.

sounds.data_hum: Low data-processing hum when lab map or content is active
sounds.hologram_shimmer: Faint crystalline shimmer when HolographicLabMap renders
sounds.content_transition: Soft whoosh on center content crossfade (400ms)
sounds.scan_sweep: Periodic scan beam sweep audio (matches HUD rotation)

center_screen.description: Center viewport audio. Positioned directly ahead. Holographic shimmer from lab map, data hum from content panels.

sounds.avatar_rotate: Soft servo whirr when avatar is rotated
sounds.guide_speak: Guide avatar speech emanates from this position
sounds.trophy_sparkle: Metallic chime when hovering earned badges
sounds.gauge_tick: Subtle tick as gauge needles move

left_console.description: Left identity hub audio. Avatar interaction, guide speech, trophy feedback. Spatially positioned to the left.

sounds.toggle_snap: Mechanical snap when ToggleSwitch3D flipped (45-degree detent)
sounds.dial_rotation: Continuous low whirr during RadialDial3D rotation, stops on release
sounds.activity_scroll: Soft tick per item when scrolling activity log
sounds.activity_new: Ping when new activity entry appears at top of feed
sounds.button_press: Metallic click with spring release for quick action buttons

right_console.description: Right control hub audio. Toggle snaps, dial whirrs, scroll ticks, button clicks. Dense mechanical feedback.

sounds.nav_button_press: Heavy metallic thunk with spring release when NavigationButtonGrid button pressed
sounds.nav_button_hover: Faint electromagnetic hum on button hover (density-dependent)
sounds.dial_cluster_rotate: Variable Dial rotation audio — pitch maps to dial value
sounds.streak_crackle: Flame crackle from streak fire animation

bottom_console.description: Bottom instrument panel audio. Navigation button presses are the most prominent — heavy, satisfying clicks. Dial rotations and status bar updates provide continuous feedback.

sounds.ring_rotation: Faint ring rotation hum — pitch shifts with rotationSpeed
sounds.data_arc_pulse: Brief pulse when data arc segment updates

hud_overhead.description: HUD overhead audio. Very subtle — creates sense of machinery above. Ring rotation and scan beams provide constant low-level spatial awareness.

sounds.pulse: LED pulse wave — sweeps left-to-right across 218-degree arc when broadcast event fires
sounds.color_shift: Subtle harmonic shift when LED color changes (lab transition)
sounds.spike: Brief bright burst on xp-gain or badge-earn events

led_rim.description: LED rim audio. Positioned along the cockpit arc edge. Pulse waves and color shift tones.

sounds.idle_beep: Random short electronic beeps from NPC bots (every 8-15 seconds)
sounds.curious_chirp: When NPC notices user hovering nearby
sounds.guide_notification: Soft chime when AI guide has something to say

npc_area.description: NPC ambient chatter. Random electronic beeps give the cockpit a lived-in feeling. Contextual responses to user proximity.

sounds.description: Each game has its own audio hooks (usePetTrainerAudio, usePromptLabAudio, useSortAudio, etc.). Game audio takes priority during game mode. Cockpit ambient reduces to 20% volume.

game_scene.description: Game audio zone. Activates in game mode. Game-specific audio engine takes over center. Cockpit ambient ducks to background.

events.description: 16 discrete audio events triggered by cockpitBroadcastStore. Each plays from the spatial position of the triggering zone.

list.description: XP gained — pitch based on amount
Ambient drone crossfades to new skin timbre

lab_crossfade.description: 10 unique generative lab soundscapes. When entering a lab route, the ambient layer crossfades to that lab's unique timbre over 1.5 seconds.
lab_crossfade.per_lab_profiles: Defined in LAB_COLOR_AUDIO_PROFILES (src/lib/audio/irisAudio.ts). Each lab maps to frequency offsets, filter types, and resonance Q values.

page_to_scene_mapping.description: Each Next.js route maps to a cockpit mode. Pages become thin React components that set the scene and provide data — NO visible HTML rendering.

html_exceptions.description: MINIMAL HTML remains — only what CANNOT be 3D
html_exceptions.marketing_body: / (below 3D hero), /pricing (table content), /terms, /privacy — SEO requires crawlable HTML body
html_exceptions.marketing_hero: 3D cockpit preview section at top of landing page (rendered in Canvas)
html_exceptions.screen_reader_nav: sr-only navigation links for WCAG accessibility compliance
html_exceptions.text_input_proxy: uikit Input uses hidden HTML <input> for keyboard/paste/autocomplete proxy — not visible but required for browser compatibility
